name: Armor / Weapon / Prop Atlas
description: Register painted artwork against a UV key. Armor and weapon presets remain supported; custom prop guides use their supplied manifest at its measured resolution with nearest filtering.

key.label: UV key
key.description: The flat PNG color-key sheet supplied to the image generator.

art.label: Generated art
art.description: The generated PNG painted over the key layout. It must have exactly the same dimensions as the UV key.

sheet.label: Sheet
sheet.description: Which key this art was painted over. Character armor defaults to 256px output; longsword defaults to 128px output. Each sheet has its own slot table.

manifest.label: Prop UV manifest
manifest.description: Required for the custom prop sheet: manifest.json from props paint plan. Its named islands, measured square size and bleed govern registration; size/bleed/filter controls below apply only to armor and weapon presets. This tool registers custom artwork; props paint import combines it with shared material tiles for the model.

name.label: Output name
name.description: Texture id below assets/textures; folders are allowed. The .png suffix is added automatically.

size.label: Atlas size
size.description: Armor/weapon presets only: square output size in pixels. Custom prop guides always retain their manifest resolution, so this control cannot silently reduce their texel density.

bleed.label: Bleed
bleed.description: Armor/weapon presets only: padding texels around UV islands. Custom prop guides retain the bleed declared by their manifest.

filter.label: Filter
filter.description: Armor/weapon presets only: box downsamples smoothly, nearest preserves pixels. Custom prop guides always use nearest filtering at their measured resolution.

slices.label: Keep slices
slices.description: Write per-island diagnostic PNGs into the local tool-run record.

artMargin.label: Artwork margin
artMargin.description: Include artwork outside the keyed islands when estimating registration.

skip.label: Skip regions
skip.description: Optional comma-separated island names that are absent from this set, such as hood,ornament.
